notes.title: Release Update - Sky Harrier: Alpha Code
notes.notes:
Hi ninjas, quick update on Sky Harrier: Alpha Code's release! 

Initially we planned for Q4 2021, but as Christmas loomed, we didn't quite pass the specification for us to release. January is, unfortunately, a tricky month for us to release a brand new game in. So, in the mean time, we've been getting SH:AC ready for release on other platforms. By getting the game out on more platforms, we hope to get more people interested in it (and hopefully, get more people to buy it!). We'll have a definite release date for you soon as well as specifics for which platforms we plan to release on--Steam will not be the only place you can get Sky Harrier: Alpha Code! 

With love,
Ninjainatux
